summary: Enumerates display modes of a graphics sub-object at this+0x10FC. First zero-fills the per-mode entry array (this[2] entries of 0x43C bytes each, resetting the count to 0), then queries the mode count through sub-object vtable slot 4 (offset 16). For each mode it probes pixel-format capabilities through vtable slot 9 (offset 36) and builds a capability bitmask; when any capability bit is set it fetches mode info (vtable slot 13, offset 52) and framebuffer data (vtable slot 5, offset 20), packs a mode record, and hands it to sub_53D8B0. Returns the number of enumerated modes.

operations.description: Guard on this[2] > 0: zero-fill the entry array only when a previous count is stored.
Zero-fill this[2] entries of 0x43C (1084) bytes each starting at this+3 (dword index), stepping 1084 bytes per entry.
Reset the entry count this[2] to 0 after the zero-fill.
Query the display mode count through vtable slot 4 (offset 16) on the sub-object at this+0x10FC.
Iterate over the returned mode count, processing one display mode per iteration.
Probe pixel-format capability through vtable slot 9 (offset 36) on the sub-object for format codes 23, 24, 25, 20 and 22; each call result is stored to this[0].
Accumulate a capability bitmask: 0x1000000 (23), 0x2000000 (24/25), 0x4000000 (24/24), 0x8000000 (20/20), 0x20000000 (22/22), 0x10000000 (22/21) when the respective capability probe fails.
Only proceed to detailed mode querying when any capability bit is set (mask & 0x3F000000) != 0.
Fetch detailed mode info through vtable slot 13 (offset 52) and framebuffer data through vtable slot 5 (offset 20) on the sub-object.
Accept the mode when the mode-info call succeeds or both stored dimensions exceed 512.
Pack the mode record v25: capability bitmask, mode index, width/height values and a name string copied from the framebuffer buffer; clear trailing fields.
Hand the completed mode record to sub_53D8B0 (0x0053D8B0) for each accepted mode.
Return the number of modes enumerated (the mode count from the first vtable query).
